india.one_line: India sees rapid AI expansion with record ChatGPT usage, new homegrown models, and fintech funding.

themes.title: ChatGPT usage spikes in India
themes.text: OpenAI reports India now has the highest weekly active user count for ChatGPT worldwide, with the user base doubling since January 2026, and announces expanded local computing, Indian-language features, Android‑first products and UPI‑related plans.

stories.headline: India becomes ChatGPT’s largest market by weekly active users, base doubles since Jan 2026

themes.title: IndiaAI Mission releases foundation models
themes.text: The IndiaAI Mission unveiled three domestically developed foundation models—EKA‑1, Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B—supporting multiple Indian languages and designed for on‑premise and offline use.

stories.headline: IndiaAI Mission unveils three indigenous AI foundation models

themes.title: PowerUp Money secures AI fintech funding
themes.text: PowerUp Money raised $10 million to develop its AI‑powered wealth advisory platform and expand its managed advisory service, serving over 1.5 million users and Rs 500 crore AUM.

stories.headline: PowerUp Money raises $10 million to expand AI‑led wealth management in India
